source.quote: The registrant had 132,532,338 shares of common stock, $0.01 par value, outstanding at October 30, 2026.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on the NYSE as DD. The count is after the 1-for-3 reverse stock split effective June 24, 2026 (the FY2025 10-K cover showed 408,923,857 shares before it) and after the November 1, 2025 spin-off of Qnity Electronics, which is a separate company and not included.
